newsitem.title: USA: Chronimed unlikely to buy Quick Check rights.
newsitem.headline: Chronimed unlikely to buy Quick Check rights.

text.p: Chronimed Inc said it appears unlikely the company will acquire the manufacturing rights for Diagnostic Solutions Inc's Quick Check reagent strip.
The strip is used in blood glucose testing for diabetes.

In March, Chronimed said its board of directors had approved negotiations to buy the rights after the U.S. Food and Drug Administration had earlier raised questions about the consistency of the strip's results.
Regardless of the ultimate resolution, Chronimed said all future financial benefits from the Quick Check product have been removed from Chronimed's projections.
Chronimed on Wednesday reported net income of $2.9 million, or $0.24 a share, for the fourth quarter ended June 27, compared to $1.6 million, or $0.12 a share, a year ago.
